target_buyer.description: Work-from-home desk owner, 25-45, phone in hand at night after a charging cable fell behind the desk again
target_buyer.context: Owns a standing desk or a wooden desk; mixes thin charger cables with thick HDMI/power cords; rents or cares about the desk finish

user_hypotheses: Buyers decide from the main image by imagining the clip on their own cable and desk
Adjustability across cable diameters matters more than pack count
An openable head that lets you swap cables without unthreading would be a differentiator
Magnetic mounting is rising because of standing desks
Sustainability claims matter but only if specific
